field_principles.field_principles: Every required field explains the evidence boundary it protects.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Inline checks stop execution when runtime evidence is unavailable.
field_principles.run_date: The fixed execution date anchors this measurement.
field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: The mandated repository and quantization are declared before cache resolution.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The declaration distinguishes model generation plus executed ARC actions from offline analysis.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: The closed class selects the honest runtime state.
field_principles.execution_venue: The host venue binds local process and GPU receipts.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time enforces the shard cap.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind code, specification, registry, and evidence inputs.
field_principles.per_game_results: The single selected game's paired outcome remains explicit.
field_principles.adapter_withheld_rows: Withheld-arm rows expose generic E3 behavior without adapter knowledge.
field_principles.adapter_visible_control_rows: Control rows show behavior when adapter lookup is separately available.
field_principles.game_selection_rows: Registry-only rank selection is frozen before outcomes.
field_principles.registry_precheck_rows: Read-only registry receipts prove eligibility and immutability.
field_principles.attempt_receipt_rows: One row per attempted policy decision binds the full evidence chain.
field_principles.prompt_hash_rows: Prompt hashes bind model inputs without duplicating bulky text.
field_principles.output_hash_rows: Output hashes bind raw model responses.
field_principles.parse_rows: Parse receipts distinguish model proposals from fallbacks.
field_principles.action_rows: Action receipts prove proposed actions were executed.
field_principles.transition_rows: Before and after hashes bind each exact environment transition.
field_principles.forecast_rows: Forecast receipts preserve the model's predicted transition.
field_principles.verifier_rows: Verifier receipts remain advisory and non-oracular.
field_principles.signal_consumption_rows: Signal receipts show whether a forecast changed action selection.
field_principles.level_rows: Level rows preserve zero as an observed outcome.
field_principles.token_rows: Token accounting enforces the bounded model-request budget.
field_principles.timing_rows: Attempt timing enforces request and shard caps.
field_principles.process_rows: Process identity binds work to the pinned local runtime.
field_principles.gpu_telemetry_rows: GPU samples bind model work to leased devices and preserve zero utilization.
field_principles.raw_trace_receipts: External trace paths and hashes keep bulky bytes outside results.
field_principles.isolation_rows: Fresh-process receipts prove the two arms did not share policy state.
field_principles.forbidden_access_rows: Denied imports and reads prove the withheld boundary.
field_principles.time_cap_rows: Explicit limits make the sixty-minute stop auditable.
field_principles.MODEL_SPECS_rows: Resolution rows record path, quantization, size, and hash.
field_principles.resolved_model_hashes: Weight hashes bind both arms to the same bytes.
field_principles.offline_reproduced: False states that this task performs no solve reproduction gate.
field_principles.headline_solve_eligible: False prevents the shard from becoming a headline solve.
field_principles.arc_registry_hash_before: The initial registry hash anchors the read-only contract.
field_principles.arc_registry_hash_after: The final registry hash detects mutation.
field_principles.arc_loo_shard_complete_score: One requires complete valid receipts from both arms.
field_principles.adapter_withheld_any_level_score: The measured withheld outcome may honestly be zero.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed matches the two arms.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A canonical digest detects aggregate drift.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: The summary records the first failed expected and observed value.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False keeps structural verification separate from ARC correctness.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class supports deterministic downstream routing.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal prefix states the current partial measurement state.

inference_substrate: bounded local E3 generation and environment actions
